shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with an adjacent unshaded interior cutout or excluded part. On the left, use the blue part of the large disk outside the two white inner disks. On the right, use the blue region inside the circle and outside the white triangle.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The fill is the outer disk with both inner disks removed. Right image: The fill selects the disk with the inscribed triangular part excluded.
Rationales: The shade identifies the remainder after leaving designated pieces out of an enclosing geometric area. Those pieces must be removed from the area computation in each panel.
